question: Which trio have song together named "Snain"
explanation: Snain is a sub-unit track that Changbin, Felix and Seungmin released together on March 27, 2023, as part of Stray Kids' SKZ-Record project on YouTube.

question: Which two Stray Kids members have a song named "Respirator"
explanation: Respirator is a duet by Han and Seungmin: they first sang it at the SKZ Magic School fan meeting in March 2024, then released it on SKZ-Record in June 2024.

question: Which duo in Stray Kids made the song "King of Nagging"
explanation: King of Nagging came from the Two Kids Song series, in which members paired up to write a song on one shared beat; it was the entry of Hyunjin and Seungmin.

question: IVE has 6 members
explanation: True. As of October 2026, IVE has six members: An Yu-jin, Gaeul, Jang Won-young, Liz, Rei and Leeseo, the same six who were introduced before the debut.

question: IVE debuted under JYP Entertainment
explanation: False. IVE was formed by Starship Entertainment, which presented it as the label's first new girl group since WJSN in 2016.

question: Wonyoung and Yujin were both in IZ*ONE before IVE
explanation: True. Jang Won-young and An Yu-jin placed first and fifth on Produce 48 in 2018, which put them in IZ*ONE until that group disbanded in April 2021.

question: IVE's debut song was 'LOVE DIVE'
explanation: False. IVE debuted with Eleven, the lead song of its first single album; Love Dive was the lead single of the second single album.

question: IVE debuted in 2022
explanation: False. IVE debuted on December 1, 2021, and gave its first broadcast performance two days later on KBS2's Music Bank.

question: Rei is from Japan
explanation: True. Rei, born Naoi Rei in Nagoya, Aichi, is a Japanese singer and rapper; she joined her agency in 2018 after passing an audition held in Japan.

question: How many members are currently in LE SSERAFIM?
explanation: As of October 2026, LE SSERAFIM has five members: Kim Chaewon, Sakura, Kazuha, Huh Yunjin and Hong Eunchae.

question: Which company does LE SSERAFIM belong to?
explanation: LE SSERAFIM was put together by Source Music, one of HYBE's sub-labels, which places the group inside the HYBE family of labels.

question: What year did LE SSERAFIM debut?
explanation: LE SSERAFIM debuted on May 2, 2022, and won its first music show eight days later, on SBS MTV's The Show.

question: Which member was previously in IZ*ONE?
explanation: Sakura and Kim Chaewon finished second and tenth on Produce 48 in 2018, made the final IZ*ONE lineup, and stayed until it disbanded in April 2021.

question: Which member is Korean-American?
explanation: Huh Yunjin was born in Seoul but grew up in the United States, in Wisconsin and New York, and holds US citizenship; Wikipedia describes her as an American singer.

question: What was LE SSERAFIM's debut song?
explanation: The group name is an anagram of I'm Fearless, and its debut EP was Fearless, led by a title song of the same name.

question: Which company does NMIXX belong to?
explanation: NMIXX was launched by JYP Entertainment through its Squ4d division, as the label's first new girl group since ITZY in 2019.

question: What year did NMIXX debut?
explanation: On February 22, 2022, NMIXX made its debut with the single album Ad Mare, a release date first made public on February 2.

question: What was NMIXX's debut song?
explanation: O.O, the lead song of the debut single album Ad Mare, launched NMIXX; a Dazed critic noted that ten lyricists were credited on it.

question: What is NMIXX's genre-blending musical style often called?
explanation: NMIXX's signature sound, which blends very different genres inside one song, is called Mixx Pop, styled MIXX POP; it divided listeners at first.

question: What was LE SSERAFIM's second title track after FEARLESS?
explanation: After the debut single Fearless, the next lead single was Antifragile, title song of the second EP released on October 17, 2022.

question: Which member of LE SSERAFIM trained in ballet before becoming an idol?
explanation: Kazuha took ballet from age three and was studying in the Netherlands, at the Dutch National Ballet Academy, when she was scouted for the group.

question: Where is Kazuha from?
explanation: Kazuha, whose full name is Kazuha Nakamura, was born in Osaka, Japan, in 2003, and works in South Korea as a member of the group.

question: Sakura was a member of which Japanese idol group before LE SSERAFIM?
explanation: Sakura joined HKT48 in 2011 and also held a concurrent AKB48 spot from 2014 to 2018, so AKB48 only is wrong; she was in IZ*ONE from 2018 to 2021 too.

question: LE SSERAFIM collaborated with which game for 'Perfect Night'?
explanation: Perfect Night, out on October 27, 2023, was the group's first English single, made with Blizzard Entertainment to promote the game Overwatch 2.

question: Who is the leader of LE SSERAFIM?
explanation: Kim Chaewon was unveiled on April 7, 2022 as both the fourth member and the leader of LE SSERAFIM, ahead of the group's May 2 debut, and she still leads it.

question: Who is the oldest member of TXT?
explanation: Yeonjun, born September 13, 1999, is the eldest: Big Hit said so when it revealed him in January 2019, and the other four members were born in 2000 or later.

question: Who is the maknae of TXT?
explanation: Hueningkai, born August 14, 2002, is the youngest of TXT; Taehyun, the next youngest, was born six months earlier, on February 5, 2002.

question: What is TXT's fandom name?
explanation: TXT's fandom is called MOA; Billboard, covering the band's second debut anniversary in March 2021, glossed the name as Moment of Alwaysness.

question: Which TXT member was a Big Hit trainee for the longest before debut?
explanation: Wikipedia gives Yeonjun about four years of Big Hit training before the 2019 debut, more than Soobin and Taehyun (three years each) and Beomgyu (two).

question: TXT was the first boy group to debut under Big Hit after which group?
explanation: Billboard reported in January 2019 that TXT was only the second boy band Big Hit had ever formed, arriving six years after BTS began in 2013.

question: What year did SHINee debut?
explanation: SHINee's first EP came out on May 22, 2008, and the group gave its first stage performance three days later, on May 25, 2008, on SBS's Inkigayo.

question: What was SHINee's debut song?
explanation: SHINee debuted with the EP Replay, fronted by a lead song of the same name; Juliette and Ring Ding Dong came in 2009 and Lucifer in 2010.

question: Who is the leader of SHINee?
explanation: Onew was chosen as SHINee's leader before the group debuted, and he started out in the group as both its leader and its lead vocalist.

question: Which SHINee member is known for his exceptional solo dance career?
explanation: Taemin has released solo music since his 2014 EP Ace and is noted for an intricate dance style; the choreography of his 2017 single Move went viral in Korea.

question: What is SHINee's fandom name?
explanation: SHINee's fans are called Shawol; Billboard, in a 2018 interview with the group, named the fandom as Shawol, also known as SHINee World.

question: Which company does SHINee belong to?
explanation: SHINee was formed by SM Entertainment, and in October 2026 SM's official website still lists SHINee among the label's artists.

question: What is the name of aespa's first full studio album?
explanation: Armageddon, released on May 27, 2024, is aespa's first studio album; Savage, Girls and My World, released before it, are EPs.

question: What are aespa's virtual counterparts called?
explanation: Each aespa member has a digital avatar called ae, such as ae-Winter and ae-Giselle; the avatars are presented as the members' alter egos living in Kwangya.

question: Who is the leader of aespa?
explanation: Karina is aespa's leader: the group's member list names her as leader, and the Korea Times called her the leader at aespa's first online press conference in 2021.

question: What is the name of TXT's first full studio album?
explanation: The Dream Chapter: Magic, out on October 21, 2019 and led by 9 and Three Quarters (Run Away), was TXT's first studio album; Star and Blue Hour are EPs.

question: What was TXT's comeback single from The Chaos Chapter: FREEZE?
explanation: 0X1=Lovesong (I Know I Love You), with Seori, was the lead single released alongside The Chaos Chapter: Freeze on May 31, 2021; the English single Magic followed a day later.

question: What is the lead single of The Name Chapter: TEMPTATION?
explanation: Sugar Rush Ride was the lead single of The Name Chapter: Temptation, the five-track EP that TXT released on January 27, 2023.

question: BTS performed at which famous American stadium for their 'Permission to Dance' concerts?
explanation: BTS played Permission to Dance on Stage at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, in the Los Angeles area, on four nights: November 27 and 28, then December 1 and 2, 2021.

question: Which K-pop act was the first to headline a UK stadium?
explanation: BTS became the first Korean band to headline London's Wembley Stadium, playing two sold-out nights there on June 1 and 2, 2019.

question: J-Hope was the first South Korean artist to headline which American music festival?
explanation: J-Hope headlined the last day of Lollapalooza on July 31, 2022, making him the first South Korean act to top a main stage at a major US music festival.

question: Which K-pop group held a free concert in Busan to support Korea's World Expo bid?
explanation: BTS gave the free show Yet To Come in Busan on October 15, 2022 to back South Korea's bid to host World Expo 2030 in Busan; it drew about 52,000 people to the stadium.

question: Lee Know used to be the MC on
explanation: Lee Know was a regular host of MBC's music show Show! Music Core from August 2021 until late 2023, sharing the job with NCT's Jungwoo.

question: What is the name of Lee Know's Hometown?
explanation: Lee Know was born in Gimpo, a city in South Korea's Gyeonggi Province, so Gimpo is his hometown rather than Incheon, Busan or Jeju.

question: Which Day6 Song did Lee Know cover on [SKZ-Record]
explanation: Lee Know sang a cover of DAY6's Love me or Leave me for SKZ-RECORD, and it was posted on Stray Kids' official YouTube channel in February 2024.

question: When is Lee Know's Birthday?
explanation: Lee Know was born on October 25, 1998, the date in Stray Kids' official JYP profile; October 3, 1997, another option, is the birthday of bandmate Bang Chan.

question: How many members are in TWICE?
explanation: As of October 2026, TWICE has nine members: Chaeyoung, Dahyun, Jeongyeon, Jihyo, Mina, Momo, Nayeon, Sana and Tzuyu.

question: Which survival show did TWICE form on?
explanation: TWICE's lineup was decided on Sixteen, an Mnet survival show that ran for ten episodes in which sixteen trainees competed for spots in the new girl group.

question: What is TWICE's fandom name?
explanation: TWICE's fans are called ONCE, a name tied to the members' message that anyone who loves them even once will get twice as much love back.

question: What year did TWICE debut?
explanation: TWICE made its official debut on October 20, 2015, releasing its first EP, The Story Begins, and promoting it with a live showcase.

question: What was TWICE's debut song?
explanation: Like Ooh-Ahh was the lead single of The Story Begins, the EP TWICE debuted with; Cheer Up, TT and Knock Knock were all singles that came later.

question: What does '127' in NCT 127 represent?
explanation: The 127 in NCT 127 stands for the longitude of Seoul, because the unit was set up as NCT's Seoul-based team promoting mainly in South Korea.

question: Which company does NCT belong to?
explanation: SM Entertainment created NCT and still manages the boy band, and NCT 127 is one of its sub-units, so the unit is an SM act too.

question: Who is the leader of NCT 127?
explanation: Taeyong was named leader of NCT 127 when the Seoul unit was set up, and as of October 2026 he is still listed as the unit's leader.

question: What year did NCT 127 debut?
explanation: NCT 127 debuted on July 7, 2016, putting out the music video for Fire Truck and performing it on M Countdown the same day.

question: NewJeans debuted in 2021
explanation: False. NewJeans debuted in July 2022; the group was first planned to launch in 2021, but the COVID-19 pandemic pushed the debut back.

question: NewJeans' debut song was 'Hype Boy'
explanation: False. NewJeans' debut single was Attention, surprise-released with its music video; Hype Boy arrived one day later as the group's second single.

question: NewJeans debuted under SM Entertainment
explanation: False. ADOR, a label under HYBE, formed NewJeans after the girl group project moved there from Source Music, another HYBE label.

question: Tteokbokki is spicy rice cakes, a popular Korean street food
explanation: True. Tteokbokki is made of cylinder-shaped rice cakes usually cooked in spicy gochujang, and it is a staple of Korean snack bars and street stalls.

question: Kimchi is made from fermented cabbage and is a staple in Korean cuisine
explanation: True. Kimchi is a side dish of salted, fermented vegetables, mainly Chinese cabbage or Korean radish, and it is served with almost every meal in Korea.

question: Soju is a type of Korean tea
explanation: False. Soju is not a tea but a clear distilled alcoholic drink from Korea, traditionally made from rice, with a taste similar to vodka.

question: Bibimbap is a mixed rice dish with vegetables and often an egg on top
explanation: True. Bibimbap, whose name means mixed rice, is warm white rice topped with seasoned vegetables and chili paste, with egg and sliced beef as common extras.

question: What was the lead single of NOEASY?
explanation: Thunderous was the lead single of Noeasy, Stray Kids' second studio album, which also gathered the earlier releases Wolfgang and Mixtape: Oh.

question: What was the lead single of ODDINARY?
explanation: Oddinary, Stray Kids' sixth EP from March 2022, was promoted with the lead single Maniac and was their first release with Republic Records.

question: What was the lead single of MAXIDENT?
explanation: Maxident, released in October 2022, was led by the single Case 143, as the band moved to a romantic concept for the first time.

question: What was the lead single of 5-STAR?
explanation: 5-Star, Stray Kids' third Korean studio album released on June 2, 2023, was promoted with the lead single S-Class and also includes a Korean version of The Sound.

question: In what year was NOEASY released?
explanation: Noeasy was released by JYP Entertainment on August 23, 2021 and became the first album by Stray Kids, and by their label, certified as a million-seller.

question: TWICE's lightstick is called 'Candy Bong'
explanation: True. K-pop acts each have their own light stick, or bong (Korean for stick), and the official one for TWICE fans is named the Candy Bong.

question: BLACKPINK's lightstick is shaped like a star
explanation: False. BLACKPINK's light stick is shaped like a hammer, not a star, and these pink glowing hammers filled the crowd at the group's 2023 tour stop at MetLife Stadium.

question: SEVENTEEN's lightstick is called 'Carat Bong'
explanation: True. SEVENTEEN's official light sticks are nicknamed Carat Bongs, a name that draws on Carat, the group's fandom name.

question: Stray Kids' lightstick has a compass design
explanation: True. Stray Kids' official light sticks use a compass motif, the same one featured on the cover of the group's March 2026 debut anniversary single.

question: What is the name of NewJeans' second EP?
explanation: Get Up, released on July 21, 2023, is NewJeans' second EP after their 2022 self-titled debut EP; OMG, How Sweet and Supernatural are single albums.

question: Which label did NewJeans originally debut under?
explanation: NewJeans debuted in July 2022 under ADOR, an independent label inside HYBE, after the girl group project moved there from Source Music.

question: Which of these groups is NOT under YG Entertainment?
explanation: BTS made its debut in 2013 with Big Hit Entertainment, while TREASURE, BIGBANG and BLACKPINK were all launched by YG Entertainment.

question: What was YG Entertainment's first major girl group?
explanation: 2NE1, launched by YG Entertainment in 2009, was the label's first major girl group; BLACKPINK and BABYMONSTER came later, and Lee Hi is a solo singer.

question: BIGBANG debuted under YG in which year?
explanation: BIGBANG officially debuted on August 19, 2006, on stage at YG Family's 10th anniversary concert at Olympic Gymnastics Arena in Seoul.

question: Which YG boy group debuted in 2020?
explanation: TREASURE, a YG Entertainment boy band, made its debut on August 7, 2020, releasing its first single album, The First Step: Chapter One, which opened at No. 1 on the Gaon Album Chart.

question: BABYMONSTER is the first YG girl group since which group?
explanation: When BABYMONSTER released its first single, Batter Up, in November 2023, it was YG's first new girl group in seven years, the one before being BLACKPINK.

question: NewJeans is known for a retro Y2K-inspired sound. Who is the creative director behind their concept?
explanation: Min Hee-jin was named creative director when HYBE and Source Music began planning the group in 2019, and she was ADOR's CEO when NewJeans debuted in 2022.

question: How many members are in KATSEYE?
explanation: As of October 2026, KATSEYE has six members: Daniela, Lara, Manon, Megan, Sophia and Yoonchae, the lineup picked when Dream Academy ended in November 2023.

question: Who is the youngest member of KATSEYE?
explanation: Yoonchae Jeung is the youngest member of KATSEYE, the girl group that HYBE and Geffen Records put together through the Dream Academy competition.

question: Who is from the Philippines?
explanation: Sophia Laforteza grew up in Manila and represented the Philippines on Dream Academy; she became the first Filipino artist signed to a HYBE label.

question: Which KATSEYE member was born in Atlanta, Georgia?
explanation: Daniela Avanzini was born in Atlanta, Georgia, on July 1, 2004, and her dance career started with local competitions in that city.

question: Who is from South Korea?
explanation: Yoonchae Jeung is a native of South Korea; she became a trainee in 2020, then won her KATSEYE spot on the Dream Academy competition.

question: Who is from Hawaii?
explanation: Megan Skiendiel was born in Honolulu, Hawaii, in February 2006, and she began formal dance training at the age of four.

question: Which KATSEYE member is from Switzerland?
explanation: Manon Bannerman is a Swiss singer: she was born in Lucerne, grew up in Zurich and started out as a social media creator in 2020.

question: Who is the leader of BTS?
explanation: RM is the leader of BTS; a former underground hip-hop rapper, he signed with Big Hit in 2010 and made his debut with the band in June 2013.

question: Who is the youngest member (maknae) of BTS?
explanation: Born on September 1, 1997, Jungkook is the youngest of the seven BTS members.

question: Who is the oldest member of BTS?
explanation: Born on December 4, 1992, Jin is the oldest member of BTS, a band he has belonged to since its 2013 debut.

question: What is RM's real name?
explanation: RM was born Kim Nam-joon in September 1994; he went by Rap Monster at first and formally switched to the stage name RM in November 2017.

question: Which member is known as the 'Golden Maknae'?
explanation: Jungkook got the nickname golden maknae because of his all-round talent, from singing to dancing, as a Billboard profile of the member explains.

question: Who is known as 'Worldwide Handsome'?
explanation: Jin gave himself the Worldwide Handsome title, joking at a May 2017 press conference in Seoul after photos of him spread widely on social media.

question: What is Suga's real name?
explanation: Suga was born Min Yoon-gi on March 9, 1993, and he also releases solo music under a second stage name, Agust D.

question: Which TWICE song went viral for its 'shy shy shy' dance?
explanation: Cheer Up, TWICE's lead single from April 2016, became a viral meme thanks to its shy shy shy line, which many celebrities copied.

question: What is the name of TWICE's first full studio album?
explanation: Twicetagram, released on October 30, 2017, was TWICE's debut studio album and their first full-length record, with 13 tracks.

question: Which TWICE song features the famous crying face dance move?
explanation: TT takes its title from the emoticon used for crying, and the TT pose in its choreography turned into a trend copied by Japanese celebrities.

question: Which member is from Taiwan?
explanation: Tzuyu is a Taiwanese singer from Tainan; talent scouts spotted her at a performing arts workshop there in 2012, and she then moved to South Korea to train.

question: Who is the leader of TWICE?
explanation: Jihyo is both the leader and a vocalist of TWICE, and in August 2023 she released her first solo EP, Zone.

question: Which TWICE member released the solo song 'POP!'?
explanation: Nayeon released Pop! on June 24, 2022 as the lead single of her debut solo EP, Im Nayeon, and it climbed as high as second place on South Korea's Circle Digital Chart.

question: How many members are in SEVENTEEN?
explanation: As of October 2026, SEVENTEEN has thirteen members, including Jeonghan, Joshua, Hoshi, Woozi, Mingyu and Dino, and they made their debut on May 26, 2015.

question: Which company does SEVENTEEN belong to?
explanation: SEVENTEEN was formed by Pledis Entertainment, which showed its trainees in the show Seventeen Project: Debut Big Plan before their 2015 debut.

question: What is SEVENTEEN's fandom name?
explanation: SEVENTEEN's fans are officially called Carat, a name revealed during a February 14, 2016 concert and taken from the unit for weighing diamonds.

question: How many units does SEVENTEEN have?
explanation: SEVENTEEN works in three units, one each for hip-hop, vocals and performance, while side projects such as BSS are counted apart as sub-units.

question: Why is the group called SEVENTEEN when they have 13 members?
explanation: The name is a sum: the 13 members, plus the 3 teams they are split into, plus 1 united group, add up to 17.

question: Who is the overall leader of SEVENTEEN?
explanation: S.Coups, born Choi Seung-cheol in 1995, is the leader of SEVENTEEN as a whole and also heads the group's hip-hop team.

question: What was Stray Kids' debut song?
explanation: Stray Kids officially debuted in March 2018 with the EP I Am Not and its title track District 9; Hellevator was an earlier, pre-debut release from 2017.

question: What is the name of Stray Kids' first full studio album?
explanation: Go Live, released on June 17, 2020, was the debut studio album of Stray Kids and topped Gaon's weekly album chart in South Korea.

question: Who are the three members of 3RACHA?
explanation: 3Racha is the in-house production team of Stray Kids, made up of Bang Chan, Changbin and Han, who were already sharing their own tracks on SoundCloud in 2017.

question: Which group released 'Super' in 2023?
explanation: Super, called Son Ogong (Monkey King) in Korean, was one of two lead singles of SEVENTEEN's EP FML, released on April 24, 2023.

question: Which group released 'S-Class' in 2023?
explanation: S-Class came out on June 2, 2023 as the lead single of 5-Star, the third Korean-language studio album by Stray Kids.

question: Which solo artist released 'Seven' in 2023?
explanation: Jung Kook of BTS released Seven, featuring Latto, on July 14, 2023, and the song entered the Billboard Hot 100 at number one.

question: Which group released 'Super Shy' in 2023?
explanation: NewJeans released Super Shy on July 7, 2023; it was the first of three singles taken from Get Up, the group's second EP.

question: Which group released 'I AM' in 2023?
explanation: I Am, lead single of IVE's first studio album I've Ive, was released on April 10, 2023 and held the top spot on the Circle Digital Chart for a total of six weeks.

question: Which group released 'UNFORGIVEN' in 2023?
explanation: Unforgiven, featuring Nile Rodgers, is the title track of LE SSERAFIM's debut studio album and was released on May 1, 2023.

question: Which survival show formed the group I.O.I?
explanation: I.O.I was formed through Produce 101, the 2016 Mnet show in which viewers chose eleven members from a pool of 101 trainees.

question: Which group was formed through the show 'Sixteen'?
explanation: Sixteen, a 2015 show made by JYP Entertainment and Mnet, had sixteen trainees compete for a place in the girl group TWICE.

question: The show 'Kingdom: Legendary War' was won by which group?
explanation: Stray Kids won Kingdom: Legendary War, finishing first in the live finale on June 3, 2021, ahead of BTOB, iKON, SF9, ATEEZ and The Boyz.

question: Which survival show formed the group Kep1er?
explanation: Girls Planet 999, which Mnet aired from August to October 2021, ended with a live finale that named the nine contestants who would debut as Kep1er.

question: Which group was formed through 'I-Land'?
explanation: On Mnet's I-Land, 23 male trainees competed, and the seven picked in the finale on September 18, 2020 debuted as ENHYPEN.

question: Which survival show brought together Korean and Japanese trainees?
explanation: Produce 48 was a 2018 joint project between Mnet's Produce 101 and Japan's AKB48, so its 96 contestants came from South Korea and Japan.

question: Which aespa song went massively viral in 2024?
explanation: Supernova, released on May 13, 2024, gave aespa its first number one on the Circle Digital Chart, spent eleven weeks on top and was South Korea's top single of the year.

question: Which group released 'Armageddon' as their first full album in 2024?
explanation: aespa released Armageddon, their first studio album, on May 27, 2024; its title track came out as a single together with the full album.

question: Which group released 'SHEESH' in 2024?
explanation: Sheesh was released on April 1, 2024 by YG Entertainment as the lead single of BABYMONSTER's first EP, Babymons7er.

question: Which group released 'Chk Chk Boom' in 2024?
explanation: Chk Chk Boom came out on July 19, 2024 as the lead single of Stray Kids' EP Ate, with a video featuring Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman.

question: Which group released 'Smart' in 2024?
explanation: Smart, an Afropop-tinged track from LE SSERAFIM's third EP Easy, followed the title track as the EP's second single on March 5, 2024.

question: Which survival show formed Kep1er?
explanation: Kep1er was formed by CJ ENM through Girls Planet 999, a competition show that aired on Mnet between August 6 and October 22, 2021.

question: What was Kep1er's debut song?
explanation: Wa Da Da was the title track of First Impact, Kep1er's debut EP, which reached number one on South Korea's Gaon Album Chart.

question: Kep1er members come from which countries?
explanation: Kep1er came from a contest for trainees from China, Japan and South Korea, and its members include Korean singers, Japan's Hikaru and China's Xiaoting.

question: What year did Kep1er debut?
explanation: Kep1er was put together on a TV contest in late 2021 but officially debuted on January 3, 2022, with the EP First Impact.

question: BLACKPINK debuted under SM Entertainment
explanation: False. BLACKPINK was put together by YG Entertainment, which launched it as the label's first new girl group since 2NE1, not by SM Entertainment.

question: Lisa is from Thailand
explanation: True. Lisa is a Thai rapper and singer: she was born in Buriram province, Thailand, and rose to fame as a member of the South Korean group BLACKPINK.

question: BLACKPINK's fandom name is BLINK
explanation: True. BLINK is the official name of BLACKPINK's fandom, a word that merges black and pink, the two halves of the group's own name.

question: Jennie was the first BLACKPINK member to debut solo
explanation: True. Jennie launched her solo career in 2018 with the song Solo, which made her the first BLACKPINK member to release music as a soloist.

question: BLACKPINK has 5 members
explanation: False. As of October 2026, BLACKPINK is a quartet of Jennie, Lisa, Jisoo and Rosé; the label first planned nine members before settling on four.

question: Rose was born in New Zealand
explanation: True. Rosé was born in Auckland, New Zealand, in February 1997 and grew up in Australia, then moved to South Korea after passing an audition in 2012.

question: BLACKPINK debuted in 2017
explanation: False. BLACKPINK debuted on August 8, 2016, with the single album Square One, which carried the songs Boombayah and Whistle.

question: Jisoo acted in the Korean drama 'Snowdrop'
explanation: True. Jisoo landed her first lead role in Snowdrop, a JTBC series that ran from 2021 into 2022, in which she starred opposite actor Jung Hae-in.

question: Stray Kids was formed through a JYP survival show
explanation: True. Stray Kids came out of a 2017 reality survival show of the same name that JYP Entertainment ran as a debut project for a new boy group.

question: Felix is from the United Kingdom
explanation: False. Felix is Australian, not British: he was born in Sydney, New South Wales, in 2000 and now works in South Korea as part of Stray Kids.

question: 3RACHA consists of Bang Chan, Changbin, and Han
explanation: True. 3RACHA, the band's main in-house production team, is the trio of Bang Chan, Changbin and Han, though the other members often help write songs too.

question: Stray Kids has 9 members
explanation: False. As of October 2026, Stray Kids has eight members: Hyunjin, Felix, Bang Chan, Seungmin, Lee Know, I.N, Han and Changbin.

question: Stray Kids debuted under SM Entertainment
explanation: False. Stray Kids is a JYP Entertainment act: JYP formed the band in 2017, and the members renewed their contracts with the agency in July 2024.

question: Bang Chan is from Australia
explanation: True. Bang Chan is an Australian singer and producer who grew up in Sydney and became a trainee in Korea after passing a 2010 global audition held in Australia.

question: Stray Kids' fandom is called STRAY
explanation: False. The Stray Kids fan club is called STAY, and in August 2026 the band put out a compilation to mark the fan club's eighth anniversary.

question: What is BTS's fandom called?
explanation: BTS fans are known as ARMY, short for Adorable Representative M.C. for Youth, a large and organized online community that translates the band's lyrics and posts.

question: What is BLACKPINK's fandom called?
explanation: BLACKPINK unveiled BLINK as its fandom name in January 2017; the word is a portmanteau of black and pink, the two parts of the group's name.

question: What is TWICE's fandom called?
explanation: TWICE's fandom is called ONCE, as Billboard noted in October 2016 while profiling the JYP girl group shortly after its first anniversary.

question: What is Stray Kids' fandom called?
explanation: STAY is the official name of the Stray Kids fan club, whose eighth anniversary the band celebrated in August 2026 with the compilation SKZ-Replay 2026 Pt.1.

question: What is SEVENTEEN's fandom called?
explanation: SEVENTEEN announced CARAT as its official fan club name at a concert on February 14, 2016; the diamond unit nods to the debut EP 17 Carat.

question: What is EXO's fandom called?
explanation: EXO-L, EXO's first official fan club, launched in August 2014. The L stands for love and sits between K and M, the letters of the EXO-K and EXO-M subunits.

question: How many members are in ATEEZ?
explanation: As of October 2026, ATEEZ has eight members, Yunho, San, Jongho, Mingi, Seonghwa, Yeosang, Wooyoung and Hongjoong, and all of them renewed their contracts in July 2025.

question: Which company does ATEEZ belong to?
explanation: ATEEZ was formed by KQ Entertainment, and in July 2025 every member agreed to renew their contract with the agency for another seven years.

question: What year did ATEEZ debut?
explanation: ATEEZ made their debut on October 24, 2018, with the EP Treasure EP.1: All to Zero, and held their debut showcase that same day.

question: Who is the leader of ATEEZ?
explanation: Hongjoong leads ATEEZ. Plans for the group began when the agency found a letter and sample mixtape he had sent, and he became the agency's first official trainee.

question: What is ATEEZ's fandom name?
explanation: ATEEZ's fans are called ATINY, a name that blends ATEEZ with destiny to say the group and its fans were always meant to meet.

question: What was ATEEZ's debut song?
explanation: Pirate King was one of two lead singles, with Treasure, on Treasure EP.1: All to Zero, the EP that launched ATEEZ, and both songs got music videos on release day.

question: Red Velvet originally debuted with 4 members before Yeri joined
explanation: True. Irene, Seulgi, Wendy and Joy debuted as a quartet with the single Happiness in August 2014, and Yeri joined as the fifth member in March 2015.

question: Red Velvet's concept alternates between 'Red' (pop) and 'Velvet' (R&B)
explanation: True. Red Velvet plays on two sides: the bright red side is mostly pop, while the more mature velvet side leans toward R&B and ballads, as with The Red and The Velvet.

question: Wendy is the main vocalist of Red Velvet
explanation: True. Wendy is Red Velvet's main vocalist, and on April 5, 2021, she made her solo debut with the mini-album Like Water, led by an emotional ballad of the same name.

question: Joy has acted in Korean dramas
explanation: True. Joy made her acting debut in 2017 as the lead of tvN's The Liar and His Lover, then starred in Tempted, The One and Only and Once Upon a Small Town.

question: Red Velvet debuted under JYP Entertainment
explanation: False. Red Velvet is an SM Entertainment group: SM began building it in 2007, when it cast Seulgi as a trainee, and debuted Red Velvet in August 2014.

question: Red Velvet's fandom name is 'ReVeluv'
explanation: True. ReVeluv is Red Velvet's official fandom name; in a 2024 Korea Times interview for the group's 10th anniversary, the members thanked their Reveluvs.

question: V from BTS acted in the drama 'Hwarang'
explanation: True. V made his acting debut in 2016 with a supporting part in KBS2's period drama Hwarang: The Poet Warrior Youth, credited under his real name, Kim Tae-hyung.

question: Jisoo from BLACKPINK acted in 'Snowdrop'
explanation: True. In the JTBC series Snowdrop, aired from December 2021 to January 2022, Jisoo played Eun Yeong-ro, a university student who hides a bloodied man in her dorm.

question: Jennie from BLACKPINK starred in 'Hotel Del Luna'
explanation: False. Hotel del Luna, a 2019 tvN series, starred IU and Yeo Jin-goo; Jennie's first acting role came later, in HBO's The Idol in 2023.

question: D.O. from EXO is known for his acting career
explanation: True. D.O. of EXO, born Doh Kyung-soo, has starred in dramas and films such as 100 Days My Prince and Swing Kids, and the Korean Film Council picked him among 200 actors representing Korean cinema.

question: Joy from Red Velvet has acted in K-dramas
explanation: True. Joy of Red Velvet has led several K-dramas, among them MBC's Tempted in 2018 and JTBC's The One and Only in 2021, after debuting as an actress in 2017.

question: All BTS members have acted in Korean dramas
explanation: False. Acting is not something all seven share: in a June 2017 profile, Billboard wrote that V was the only BTS member pursuing an acting career.

question: BTS also uses 'Beyond The Scene' as a meaning for their name
explanation: True. BTS comes from Bangtan Sonyeondan, literally Bulletproof Boy Scouts, and in July 2017 the band announced the letters would also stand for Beyond the Scene.

question: SEVENTEEN is named after having 17 members
explanation: False. As of October 2026, SEVENTEEN has 13 members; the name comes from the sum of 13 members, 3 teams and 1 group, which adds up to 17.

question: NCT stands for 'Neo Culture Technology'
explanation: True. NCT is an initialism of Neo Culture Technology, the name SM Entertainment founder Lee Soo-man used when presenting the multi-unit boy group project in January 2016.

question: LE SSERAFIM is an anagram of 'I'M FEARLESS'
explanation: True. When the name LE SSERAFIM was revealed in March 2022, it was explained as an anagram of I'm Fearless that also nods to the six-winged seraphim.

question: TXT stands for 'Tomorrow X Together'
explanation: True. TXT is the common short form of TOMORROW X TOGETHER, a name the group's site says refers to five people united by one dream of building a better tomorrow.

question: ATEEZ means 'A TEEnager Z' representing teenagers from A to Z
explanation: True. ATEEZ, a name unveiled in July 2018, is short for A TEEnager Z and is meant to show the group speaks for all things teenage, from A to Z.

question: What is ENHYPEN's first full studio album?
explanation: DIMENSION : DILEMMA, out on October 12, 2021, was ENHYPEN's first studio album and became their first record to sell more than a million copies.

question: What is the lead single of DARK BLOOD?
explanation: Bite Me was the lead single of DARK BLOOD, ENHYPEN's fourth EP, which Belift Lab released on May 22, 2023, together with the song's music video.

question: Which ENHYPEN song has a party/drunk concept with colorful visuals?
explanation: Drunk-Dazed, the darker pop-rock title track of BORDER : CARNIVAL (April 2021), pictures fame as a dizzying carnival, and NME said its mix feels like hearing the members over the din of a party.

question: What was ENHYPEN's first EP called?
explanation: BORDER : DAY ONE was ENHYPEN's debut EP: it came out on November 30, 2020, with the lead single Given-Taken and a live showcase.

question: What is the name of IVE's first full studio album?
explanation: I've IVE, which came out on April 10, 2023, is IVE's first studio album; Kitsch was released ahead of it, and I AM served as its lead single.

question: Which IVE member is Japanese?
explanation: Rei is IVE's member from Japan: born Rei Naoi in Nagoya, Aichi, she is a Japanese singer and rapper who works in South Korea with Starship Entertainment.

question: Who is the youngest member of IVE?
explanation: Leeseo, born in 2007, is IVE's youngest member, as the Korea Times pointed out in its August 2025 review of the group's EP IVE SECRET.

question: Which song came first: 'LOVE DIVE' or 'After LIKE'?
explanation: LOVE DIVE came first: IVE released it as a single album on April 5, 2022, and After LIKE followed on August 22, 2022, while I AM only arrived in 2023.

question: What is the name of TWICE's song about being there for someone through hard times?
explanation: Feel Special is about the people who help you stand up again: TWICE's Nayeon said it reflects how members and fans helped them through tough times in their career.

question: Which TWICE song has a retro disco concept?
explanation: I Can't Stop Me (2020) is an 80s-style synthwave pop song with touches of disco, and its colorful music video has a retro atmosphere.
